verdict.rationale: TWC's registration page states some of the account and credential path before you start. You register through UTR and immediately receive a tax account number if liable (tx-twc-docs-3). Any reports or taxes due must be filed during registration (tx-twc-docs-4). The same user ID and password then work in UTS (tx-twc-docs-5). The pack does not describe identity-proofing requirements or a complete upfront list of credentials. Missing for 10: documented identity-proofing/verification steps, an explicit up-front checklist of required credentials and documents, and independent confirmation that no unstated walls appear mid-flow.
